ns2:section.sectionText: Practice type course. May be repeated. It is expected that students enrolling in this course for Fall or Spring semesters will work at least 12 weeks during the semester, and students enrolling for Summer will work at least 8 weeks during summer. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Graduate student standing or consent of Director of Engineering Career Services. Work Report, online Company Card Report, and online ABET Report required.
